pr_title: internal/ethapi, graphql: improve handling of gpo.maxprice setting
pr_body:
Previously the `gpo.maxprice` is only applied for transaction tip. It works before London since there is no baseFee. But after the london basefee dominates the transaction cost, the `gpo.maxprice` is more or less useless right now.

In this PR, the `gpo.maxprice` is applied for the final transaction gas price users need to pay, instead of only tip. And also this PR emphasizes the semantics of this flag: `Maximum gas price users can afford`

Fixes #23490
pr_comments: Note: interesting question is what happens when the maxprice is configured lower than the current basefee. In this case, geth should create a tx with maxfee = maxprice, but still use the normal tip estimation.

Carefully think about it. I think the correct way to limit the max gasprice is to send 1559 txs. The `--gpo.maxprice` should only be used for tip capping after london or price capping before london.

Close it now. Will open a PR to update the flag description.

issue_context.title: Max price option don't work
issue_context.body:
#### System information
Geth version: `1.10.8-stable`
OS & Version: Linux
Commit hash : 26675454bf93bf904be7a43cce6b3f550115ff90

#### Expected behaviour
`--gpo.maxprice` work

#### Actual behaviour
I set `--gpo.maxprice 270000000000` to our client but it sent transaction with 480 GWei gas price.

#### Steps to reproduce the behaviour
I also set `--gpo.percentile 100` if it isn't reproducible with only `--gpo.maxprice`
comments: The `--gpo.maxprice` refers to the maximum priority gasprice. But the returned one is the priority+basefee. But you are right we should either update the doc or fix it in the code to keep the original behavior.

Dear @rjl493456442 ,
I had encountered to this issue again. Ethereum was sent with over 500 GWei. What is the basefee default value?

@aghamir Hi! I realized that my previous direction was wrong. In order to limit the max gasprice properly, you have to use 1559 transaction format by setting `maxFeePerGas`. 

The description of `--gpo.maxprice` has to be updated, now it's only used to limit the tip suggestion.
Answered by @rjl493456442 , closing. Feel free to reopen if you think there's still some issue here

review_comments: I wonder if this change is really needed, or if it's something that you changed to get around the flakey test that was fixed in https://github.com/ethereum/go-ethereum/pull/23599 ?
It's not flaky test, it's because originally the basefee is derived from the Latest block, now we use the Pending block instead.
